# SSH key fixtures

Every key in this directory is a throwaway test key generated by `gen.sh`.
None of them protects anything; do not reuse them. Encrypted fixtures use the
passphrase `correct horse battery`.

`expected.txt` lists the public key `ssh-keygen -y` printed for each fixture
when it was generated; the tests compare the parsers against it.

PuTTY `.ppk` files are not included because no `puttygen` was available when
the fixtures were made; `sshkey_test.go` writes PPK files from PuTTY's format
description instead.
